detected_fault: Battery drain while gaming even when plugged in
suggested_solution: Run a battery calibration test using built-in Windows tools (e.g., Powercfg.cpl) to ensure accurate battery readings.
Check for driver updates and install the latest NVIDIA GeForce drivers.
Verify that power management settings are set correctly, ensuring that the laptop is not set to "Low Power Mode" or "Power Saver".
Perform a thorough stress test using tools like Prime95, OCCT, or FurMark to identify any hardware issues.
